title: Give back his flesh in inseparable union
english: But give back to him his flesh in an inseparable union, and do not strip him of the veil. For in this way you will worship one Son, consubstantial with the Father divinely, and the same one consubstantial with us humanly. To those who have chosen to think thus, Christ will reveal the knowledge of the mystery concerning himself.

For the nature of humanity in Christ was being honored and sanctified. As to what pertains to being, he would not have needed baptism, nor to share in the Holy Spirit. Most of all it will suffice for full assurance that he himself is the giver of the Spirit.

title: The humanity in Christ was honored and sanctified
english: Divinely, consubstantial with the Father; and with us, the same one humanly. To those chosen to think thus Christ will reveal the knowledge of his own mystery. For the humanity in Christ was being honored and sanctified. For as far as his own being is concerned, he would not have needed baptism, nor indeed to share in the Holy Spirit. Most of all it will suffice for full assurance that he himself is the giver of the Spirit.

title: Christ reveals the mystery to those who think rightly
english: Divinely, consubstantial, and also to us the same humanly. To those who think thus Christ will reveal the knowledge of his own mystery. For the humanity in Christ was being honored and sanctified. For as far as his own being is concerned, he would not have needed baptism, nor indeed to share in the Holy Spirit. Most of all it will suffice for full assurance that he himself is the giver of the Spirit.
